evidence.title: Incident Report: Apapa Bonded Warehouse
evidence.content:
A pallet of imported diagnostic equipment (manifest ref DX-771) is logged by shift supervisor Tunde Balogun as "damaged in transit and destroyed per protocol." No destruction certificate was filed with the port authority, which is required for cargo of this value.

Balogun submitted a photo (see Media) as his only supporting documentation.

evidence.title: Tunde Balogun: Shift Statement
evidence.content: "The pallet was crushed when the loader clipped it moving stock. I logged it as destroyed same as always. I took a photo for the file, that's standard practice. I don't know what more you want from me."

evidence.title: Decrypted Resale Ledger
evidence.content:
PRIVATE LEDGER — RECOVERED

ITEM: Diagnostic unit, lot DX-771 (x1 pallet)
BUYER REF: Corvid Risk Partners
PAYMENT ROUTE: Intermediary courier, cash-settled
TOOLKIT SIG: TK-5F3C9A

ANALYSIS: No destruction occurred. The pallet was resold intact. The buyer reference does not match any registered clinic or hospital account.

evidence.title: Corvid Risk Partners — Registration Snapshot
evidence.content: A shell entity registered eleven months prior, listed address a virtual mailbox in Lagos. No further filings on record. Flagged here only as background — nothing yet connects it to anything else.

chat.text: Small one to open your file with. Should be quick.
Apapa warehouse, missing pallet, supervisor's story doesn't quite add up. File's attached. Should be a quick close.
Balogun, I need the destruction cert for DX-771 by morning or the insurer flags the whole shipment.
Working on it. Loader clipped the pallet bad, it's scrap. Sending a photo now so you've got something for the file.

reveal.revealText: Chalk marking, lower-left crate edge: APAPA-BAY7. The pallet is intact — not crushed.

suspects.name: Tunde Balogun
suspects.notes: Claims accidental damage. His own photo, once brightened past the point of legibility, shows an intact, chalk-marked crate — the opposite of his story.

solution.successMessage: Clean work. The photo he sent to cover himself is the same photo that convicts him — brighten it past what he expected anyone to bother with, and the crate he swore was destroyed is sitting there intact, chalk-marked. Ledger confirms the rest.

onDocument.c1_ev04: A shell company, nothing more. Worth a line in Notes, nothing more than that yet.

onThread.c1_thread02: He sent this photo to cover himself. Look closer than he expected anyone to.

onFlag.CRATE_CODE_SEEN: The crate code was never hidden — it was just underexposed. Someone didn't think anyone would turn the brightness up.

onBookmark.c1_ev04: Bookmarked. Corvid Risk Partners. Probably nothing.

narrativeBeats.onSubmitSuccess: Balogun folds fast — says he was paid by an intermediary he never met, in cash, no questions. Case closed.
